provenance: Host-authored direct program with constructor/source review, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: Search every colour component for solid-border rectangles with single-colour interior dots in distinct rows and columns. Return the unique output among maximum-area candidates; expand each dot across its row and column. All geometry is visible-coordinate and palette-independent. No largest-component assumption, edge-majority threshold, fallback or scan-order tie.
draft_notes.limitations: The largest valid dotted box is the explicit sampling convention. Random samples are rejected when their latent crop disagrees with that convention or equally large boxes yield different outputs. Explicit historical calls and benchmark fixtures remain unchanged. The per-episode verifier remains required.
draft_notes.diagnosis:
The failed factory, like the archived solver, found the box by peeling bounding-box edge lines whose box-colour fraction was strictly below 0.5. In the counterexample test (box colour 4 at rows 6-11, cols 3-9, dots of colour 8), noise placed 4s at (7,10), (9,10) and (11,10). Column 10 over rows 6-11 therefore reads 0,4,3,4,3,4, which is exactly 3/6 = 0.5. It was not peeled, and the program cropped a 6x8 grid instead of the correct 6x7.

The heuristic fails because the constructor never guarantees that adjacent noise lines are less than half box colour. The actual visible invariant is different: the box border is entirely box colour, because dots are strictly interior. The repaired solver uses that invariant: the largest rectangle with a solid box-colour border whose interior non-box cells are single-colour dots in distinct rows and columns. This is a general mechanism fix, not a special case for this counterexample.
draft_notes.constructor_issue: Noise can extend an entire box edge, allowing identical inputs with different latent crop labels. Random generation now requires agreement with the unique visible maximum-area output; bounded at 1000 attempts. No estimate of rarity is claimed.

draft_notes.host_review: Replaced largest-component selection and arbitrary rectangle tie with exhaustive solid-border candidate search across all colours/components, retaining one largest-box output. Random generation rejects output ambiguity or latent crop disagreement; explicit path and long fixture lists unchanged. No majority-edge heuristic.
